name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge

instructions.description: Lie on the back with both knees bent, then extend one foot and lift slightly off the floor.
Keep the pelvis level and press through the supporting foot.
Lift the hips without rotating the trunk.
Lower slowly and repeat on the other side.

commentsNotes: Regress to the bilateral bridge if pelvic control is difficult.

variations.variationDescription: Glute Bridge provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Single-Leg Glute Bridge.
Single-Leg Glute Bridge — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Single-Leg Glute Bridge — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
